prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new HAVENLINE World 1 upgrade-design proposal sheet, using the supplied selected base image(s) as immutable design-family references. Premium chunky rounded stylized 3D mobile-game art, warm orange timber, navy/blue painted metal, rounded steel brackets, light sculpted snow, clean navy studio background. Two authored appearance proposals, NOT numeric equipment levels and NOT unlocks: top row REINFORCED; bottom row ADVANCED. Exact 2-row by 3-column board. Each row depicts the SAME object consistently in front three-quarter, rear three-quarter, and close functional side/detail view. Six clear roomy panels, identical design features across that row, neutral studio lighting. Header HAVENLINE / WORLD 1 / SAW STATION. Small subtitle APPEARANCE STUDY. Short labels only. No level numbers, costs, stats, new recipes, characters, HUD, watermarks, decorative clutter, giant growth, or giant resource models. Upgrades must be visually meaningful through engineered reinforcements and material improvements, remain recognizably the selected original, and retain compact footprint, input/output positions, service clearances and underlying purpose. These are authored concept designs, not observed reference-video claims. Do not redraw the retained base as an extra tier.
Evolve exactly the selected compact wooden sawing table: four sturdy legs, front exposed circular blade with crank, horizontal log clamped across rear tabletop, upper timber clamp bar, small plank bay under table. This is one sawing producer; do NOT turn it into a different lumber mill or steam saw. Top row reinforced: rounded blue steel corner plates, reinforced clamp guides, partial blade guard that leaves log cutting path and hand crank usable, sturdy braces within same footprint. Bottom row advanced: blue underframe reinforcement, improved protective guard and log guides, upgraded clamp mechanism, tidy visible output/plank support, still original compact table and recognizable circular cutting wheel. Preserve consistent clamp, crank and cutting orientation across front/rear views. No extra conveyor, no new engine type, no assigned production rates. Keep log and plank size consistent with base rather than enormous. The third panel in each row is a meaningful close side view of clamp/blade/crank clearances, not an unrelated machine.
